resources.name: training-postgres (postgres db.t3.micro)
resources.monthly_cost_risk: RDS databases bill for compute and storage continuously. Even a stopped instance is auto-started after 7 days and keeps paying for storage.
resources.suggested_action: Confirm you still need this database. If it was for a lab, take a final snapshot (optional) and delete it manually.
